The '''2027 Joburg Super Kings season''' is the fifth season of the franchise in the [[SA20]].<ref>{{cite web |title=BETWAY SA20 SEASON 5 FIXTURES ANNOUNCED |url=https://www.sa20.co.za/news/betway-sa20-season-5-fixtures-announced |date=23 July 2026 |access-date=24 July 2026 |website=SA20.co.za |language=en}}</ref> The team is captained by [[Faf du Plessis]] and coached by [[Albie Morkel]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.espncricinfo.com/story/sa20-albie-morkel-named-head-coach-of-joburg-super-kings-1548113|title=Albie Morkel named head coach of Joburg Super Kings|work=Cricinfo|access-date=30 July 2026}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.joburgsuperkings.com/news-detail/516|title=Joburg Super Kings Appoint Albie Morkel as Head Coach|work=Cricinfo|access-date=30 July 2026}}</ref>
